name: London Ambulance Service
description: The London Ambulance Service dispatches ambulances in emergencies. The key goal is to allocate an available ambulance for every call that can reach the scene within 11 minutes. The entire dispatch process must not exceed a set maximum time limit. The Computer Aided Despatch system analyzes incident forms and assigns vehicles. The exact location of moving ambulances must be tracked, requiring ambulance staff to follow standard routes and communicate departure and destination information so that radio operators and the CAD can accurately record the corresponding data.
highLevelGoals: Ambulance staff aim to contribute to reaching emergency scenes within the 11-minute target to provide critical care and ensure patient safety.
Ambulance staff need to provide timely and accurate location and status updates to support efficient dispatch and resource allocation.
Radio operators aim to accurately record ambulance movement data to ensure a reliable historical log of dispatches and responses.
Radio operators need to ensure that recorded data is consistent and accurately reflected in the Computer Aided Despatch (CAD) system to provide up-to-date information for dispatch decisions.
The Dispatch Operator aims to efficiently allocate an available ambulance for every call to meet the 11-minute response time target and maximize operational effectiveness.
The Dispatch Operator seeks to ensure the entire dispatch process does not exceed the set maximum time limit to facilitate rapid emergency response.
The Dispatch Operator needs to utilize accurate analysis of incident forms from the CAD system to facilitate correct and timely vehicle assignments.
The Dispatch Operator requires real-time and accurate visibility of ambulance locations to make informed dispatch decisions and manage ongoing incidents effectively.
